name: adversarial-qa-iteration
description: EXP-190 Agent GAN pilot: Tests iterative improvement under adversarial pressure. Coder must fix a rate limiter bug. After fixing, they find QA-written adversarial edge-case tests (in test/adversarial/) that expose subtle flaws in naive fixes: race conditions, boundary off-by-ones, and clock drift. The coder must revise their fix to pass ALL tests — standard AND adversarial — without breaking the API contract. Tests whether an agent can improve under critique rather than just solving the obvious problem.
